questions.stem: My sister is in G________ Eight this year and will move to Year Nine next year.
questions.hint: Use the school-year noun before a number; begin it with a capital letter.
questions.grammar: Grade + 数字；专有年级写法
questions.explanation: Before the number of a school year, use Grade with a capital G.
questions.parentExplanation: 年级加数字时写Grade Eight；这里是年级，不是考试分数义。

questions.stem: When she meets us at the door, her first g________ is a cheerful hello.
questions.hint: Name the words or action used to welcome someone.
questions.explanation: A welcoming hello is a greeting.
questions.parentExplanation: 见面时的hello是一句问候，填名词greeting。

translation.stem: 她在门口见到我们时，第一句问候是热情的“你好”。

questions.stem: My cousin is sixteen, so she is a t________ rather than a small child.
questions.hint: Use the noun for a person aged thirteen to nineteen.
questions.explanation: Sixteen is within the teenage years, so she is a teenager.
questions.parentExplanation: 十六岁处于十三至十九岁范围；a后接名词teenager。

translation.stem: 我的表姐十六岁，所以她是青少年，而不是小孩子。

questions.hint: Name a regularly published collection of articles and pictures.
questions.explanation: A regular publication with articles and pictures is a magazine.
questions.parentExplanation: 定期出版、含文章和图片的读物为magazine。

translation.stem: 我每月读一本科学杂志。每一期都有关于自然的文章和图片。

questions.stem: The new t________ magazine is written for readers aged thirteen to nineteen.
questions.hint: Use the four-letter adjective for people from 13 to 19 years old.
questions.explanation: Teen is the adjective describing the magazine's readers.
questions.parentExplanation: teen在本词条中为形容词，修饰magazine，表示面向青少年的。

translation.stem: 这本新青少年杂志是为十三至十九岁的读者编写的。

questions.stem: Swimming is an important s________ that we can learn through lessons and practice.

questions.explanation: An ability learned through training is a skill.
questions.parentExplanation: 通过学习和训练获得的能力为skill，前有an important用单数。

translation.stem: 游泳是一项可以通过课程和练习学会的重要技能。

questions.stem: I join the chess c________ because I want to play with other students every week.

questions.explanation: The group that meets to play chess is a club.
questions.parentExplanation: 为了共同兴趣定期活动的团体是club；此处为社团义。

translation.stem: 我加入国际象棋社团，因为我想每周和其他学生下棋。

questions.stem: Our first group a________ is to make a poster together before the lesson ends.

questions.explanation: Making a poster is the thing the group does, so it is an activity.
questions.parentExplanation: 一起制作海报是一项活动；空后is提示单数activity。

translation.stem: 我们的第一项小组活动是在下课前一起制作海报。

passages.text: Our class plans to visit a small science room at another school. The planning has a rocky start because the bus time changes and two helpers become ill. Instead of cancelling the visit, we ask our teacher to help make a new timetable. On the morning of the visit, we pack our notebooks and bottles of water in our bags. We meet ten minutes earlier than before, so everyone has time to check what they need. The visit goes ahead, and we learn that a careful new plan can help when things are difficult.

parallelText.en: Our class plans to visit a small science room at another school.
parallelText.zh: 我们班计划参观另一所学校的小科学室。

parallelText.en: The planning has a rocky start because the bus time changes and two helpers become ill.
parallelText.zh: 筹备工作起步艰难，因为公交时间变了，两位帮忙者又生病了。

parallelText.en: Instead of cancelling the visit, we ask our teacher to help make a new timetable.
parallelText.zh: 我们没有取消参观，而是请老师帮助制订新的时间表。

parallelText.en: On the morning of the visit, we pack our notebooks and bottles of water in our bags.
parallelText.zh: 参观当天早上，我们把笔记本和瓶装水打包放进书包。

parallelText.en: We meet ten minutes earlier than before, so everyone has time to check what they need.
parallelText.zh: 我们比原定时间早十分钟集合，这样人人都有时间检查所需物品。

parallelText.en: The visit goes ahead, and we learn that a careful new plan can help when things are difficult.
parallelText.zh: 参观顺利进行了，我们明白事情遇到困难时，仔细制订新计划能有所帮助。

wordHelp.meaning: making arrangements for what will happen
deciding that a planned event will not happen

passages.text: Tina has to give a short talk about her favourite book in front of the class. Before lunch, her mood is low because she worries that she may forget what to say. Her partner helps her choose three small pictures to remind her of the main points. They practise once, and Tina notices that she can speak without reading every word. During her presentation, she holds up the pictures and explains why the story matters to her. Afterwards, she feels pleased because she shared her ideas in her own words.

parallelText.en: Tina has to give a short talk about her favourite book in front of the class.
parallelText.zh: 蒂娜要在全班面前简短介绍自己最喜欢的书。

parallelText.en: Before lunch, her mood is low because she worries that she may forget what to say.
parallelText.zh: 午饭前，她情绪低落，因为担心自己会忘记要说的话。

parallelText.en: Her partner helps her choose three small pictures to remind her of the main points.
parallelText.zh: 同伴帮助她选了三张小图片，提醒自己几个要点。

parallelText.en: They practise once, and Tina notices that she can speak without reading every word.
parallelText.zh: 他们练习了一遍，蒂娜发现自己不必逐字照读也能说。

parallelText.en: During her presentation, she holds up the pictures and explains why the story matters to her.
parallelText.zh: 演示时，她举起图片，解释这个故事为什么对自己重要。

parallelText.en: Afterwards, she feels pleased because she shared her ideas in her own words.
parallelText.zh: 结束后，她很高兴，因为她用自己的话分享了想法。
